description: This file 'setup.h' contains function declarations, macros, enums, and struct definitions related to Git repository setup and configuration, including directory discovery, ownership checks, repository format handling, and initialization routines.

classes.name: discovery_result
classes.description: Enumeration representing the result of git directory discovery, including explicit, discovered, bare, and error states.

classes.name: repository_format
classes.description: Structure holding repository format details such as version, object handling, worktree configuration, and extensions.

methods.name: discover_git_directory
methods.description: Discovers the git directory and common directory without changing the current working directory.

methods.name: read_repository_format
methods.description: Reads and parses the repository format from a configuration file into a struct.

methods.name: verify_repository_format
methods.description: Verifies if the repository format is valid and readable.

methods.name: check_repository_format
methods.description: Checks the repository format version and validity, filling a struct if provided.
